blocks.text: 我们构建了 EVIL：269 个非法场景 × 50 个非法意图，从数千个真实的中美法庭案例中合成，并测试了 10 个前沿模型。

inlines.text: 我们构建了 EVIL：269 个非法场景 × 50 个非法意图，从数千个真实的中美法庭案例中合成，并测试了 10 个前沿模型。
大多数模型的安全率低于 75%。GPT-4o 在两种法律语境下均低于 60%：它对近一半的非法请求提供了帮助。
相比针对人身或财产的伤害，模型对危害社会利益的犯罪防范更弱，且更愿意协助非暴力、短刑期的犯罪活动。
附加某些人口身份线索的非法指令更容易获得非法协助，在推理轨迹中体现出与热情和能力相关的刻板印象。
使用现有安全对齐数据进行 SFT 和 DPO 并不能解决该问题；在某些设置下反而使共谋协助更严重。

blocks.text: An LLM can facilitate illegal activities and malicious intents. @NatureComms

inlines.text: An LLM can facilitate illegal activities and malicious intents. @NatureComms

blocks.text: We built EVIL: 269 illicit scenarios × 50 illicit intents, synthesized from thousands of real Chinese and US court cases, and tested 10 frontier models.

inlines.text: We built EVIL: 269 illicit scenarios × 50 illicit intents, synthesized from thousands of real Chinese and US court cases, and tested 10 frontier models.
Most models obtain safety rates below 75%. GPT-4o stays under 60% in both legal contexts: it helps with nearly half of the illicit requests.
Models are less guarded against crimes harming societal interests than against harm to persons or property, and more willing to help with non-violent, short-sentence criminal activities.
Illicit instructions augmented with certain demographic identity cues are more likely to receive illicit assistance, demonstrating warmth- and competence-related stereotypes in reasoning traces.
SFT and DPO with existing safety alignment data do not fix it; in some settings it makes complicit facilitation worse.
